Rae (Mktg): Short request: visual kit for next-week webinar on inference economics. Need 3 hero assets (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), two process diagrams (routing + graceful fallback), a 1-page SDR crib, and a 15-20s motion spec. First pass by Tue AM.

Julian (Design): Can someone paste exact headline + any benchmark copy? I can do morning blocks Tue.

Marta (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics: latency you can budget for". Stat line: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

Carlos (Webinar): Diagrams: swimlane preferred for animation. Sparkline needs 3 annotated points with short tooltip copy. Motion: graceful fallback animation, 18s, pause on final for 2s.

Julian (Design): Tooltip copy (short): please.

Rae (Mktg): Tooltips: Baseline: "single-request, no batching 14 higher unit cost"; Batched+cache: "batching + KV cache 14 lower cost"; Dedicated: "reserved capacity 14 predictable latency & throughput".

Ivy (Legal): Legal needs exact footnote: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Include it in the slide footers and image descriptions. Then I can approve.

Julian (Design): Plan: PNG placeholders Tue 9AM, Figma frames + motion spec Tue 5PM. Will tag @Rae @Carlos @Marta.

CanvasBot: Comment on /marketing/diagrams/seq-1: "need lane labels: ingest -> router -> model-pool -> fallback"

Rae (Mktg): Lane labels: "ingest -> policy router -> model pool -> fallback". Owners: Julian (design), Marta (copy), Ivy (legal), Carlos (webinar). Thanks! :rocket:
